summary.intent: Autonomously run the full post-execute-phase 'ship loop' for GSD phase 69 (FUSE/WinFsp Rust integration + grant-root awareness): verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit review, ship as a PR, resolve all review threads, and extract learnings — without requiring user babysitting, deferring risky/out-of-scope findings as todos.
summary.outcome: PR #594 opened and shipped with all local gates passing (verification PASS, security SECURED with 0 open threats, validation compliant, ~13 verified-safe CodeRabbit/Greptile fixes applied including a CRITICAL read-after-write EIO bug and a cross-client decryption bug from a hex-vs-base64 file_iv encoding mismatch), all PR CI checks green, and 9 review threads resolved; the user-added Desktop E2E hard gate surfaced and led to fixing that decryption bug live, with residual non-product failures (Linux postgres-setup CI flake, Windows-only legacy test-helper crash) still being chased when the transcript ends.

repo: cipher-box squash-merges PRs onto main, so branch commit subjects never reach release-please post-merge — only the PR title and pr-release-preview.js (which tolerates parens in descriptions and skips merge commits) matter; a filter-branch reword of already-conventional commits is unnecessary scope creep.
github-actions[bot] pushes a chore(release) commit to the PR branch after gh pr create and after a passing Release Preview — always git fetch + rebase before the next push or it's rejected.
gh pr edit fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL; patch the PR body via `gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file` instead.

coderabbit CLI times out summarizing full diffs >~100 files/24k lines; scope with `--dir` per top-level package (e.g. crates/sdk, crates/fuse) to get real results, and expect free-tier rate-limiting (46min) on additional scoped runs.
Local commits can report a hang/timeout during signing (1Password SSH signing) that is a false negative — always verify with `git log --oneline -1` before retrying, per existing memory.
clippy is not CI-gated in this repo; don't manufacture repo-wide clippy fixes during a 'simplify' pass — only fix genuine dead code/duplication in net-new phase files.

Windows CI (`cargo-windows` job) and the Desktop E2E matrix require the WinFsp platform layer (plan 69-14) to compile; that plan is intentionally `autonomous:false`/CI-only because winfsp code never compiles under local macOS cargo.

The Desktop E2E CI workflow (`desktop-e2e.yml`) is `workflow_dispatch`-gated with no required inputs — dispatch via `gh workflow run "Desktop E2E Tests" --ref <branch>` to run the full macOS/Windows/Linux matrix on demand; it does not run automatically on normal PR pushes.

NodeContent.file_iv had a cross-language encoding divergence: the Rust FUSE mount encoded/decoded it as hex, while the shipped TS/web node/v3 read chain (packages/sdk-core) treats it as base64 — causing every cross-client content read of mount-written files to fail AES-GCM decryption. The KAT vectors never caught this because the sample IV bytes are valid as both hex and base64.

packages/sdk-core/scripts/bump-ipns-sequence.ts was missed by the 69-25 node/v3 migration and still references the legacy model (vaultKeyBlob.rootFolderKey, folder.metadata.children, publishFolderMetadata), causing an undefined.length crash on Windows conflict-detection E2E.

Linux desktop-e2e CI runs can fail at the Postgres setup action itself ('postgres-version must be one of: 14,15,16,17,18') — an infra flake unrelated to product code, distinct from failures inside the test steps.

code.finding: publish_file_node emits file_iv as base64 (was hex) to match the TS/web node/v3 read contract; read paths base64-decode at content_ops.rs:155 (GCM) and :164 (CTR).
Journaled placeholder NodeContent.file_iv now encoded consistently with the base64 fix so replay.rs publishes correctly without further changes.

is_unresolved predicate duplicated the enclosing cid.is_empty() check, making the pending_content/empty-file fallback unreachable — caused read-after-write EIO on locally-buffered files (CRITICAL fix: serve pending_content before the unresolved-FP poll).
InodeKind's derived Debug leaked key material via Zeroizing's forwarding Debug impl; replaced with a manual redacting Debug impl.

fetch_node_gated's own-resolve path feeds the locally-trusted floor as the 'attempted' generation (floor-vs-floor comparison), a deliberate faithful port of the TS dfsFindFolder Pitfall-3 rule; not a bypass because seq is IPNS-signature-bound.
Fail-closed rejection of legacy v2 vault blobs is intentional per plan 69-19's clean flag-day cutover (no prod v2 vaults exist), not a backward-compat regression.

workflow: When orchestrating heavy test suites (cargo test --workspace) as the lead agent, run them centrally/in background rather than delegating to parallel subagents to avoid RAM starvation.

For crypto/revocation-sensitive CodeRabbit/Greptile findings, spawn parallel adversarial-verification subagents with explicit context (faithful-TS-port model, single-daemon assumptions, known zeroization-reuse trap) rather than blind-applying suggested fixes; this caught several false positives that would have damaged working code.
When multiple verification subagents' fixes touch overlapping files, hold all edits until every agent returns and apply one coherent pass to avoid racing concurrent reads.
zsh treats $status as a read-only special variable — using it as a custom variable name in polling scripts causes silent failures; use a different name.
gh api GraphQL mutations (reply/resolve on PR review threads) can fail silently/flakily; wrap them in a retry loop and re-query afterward to confirm 0 unresolved and no duplicate replies.

When a CI failure signature is identical across multiple dispatch runs and platforms (including runs predating a related fix), that's a strong signal the root cause is pre-existing/unrelated to the most recent change, not a regression from it.

Static/code-reading analysis has diminishing returns for cross-service crypto bugs; delegating to a dedicated debugger that reproduces locally with granular logging found the definitive root cause (file_iv encoding) after static analysis alone was inconclusive.

friction: CodeRabbit CLI timed out summarizing the full 125-file/24k-line phase diff, requiring a fallback to per-directory scoped reviews.
CodeRabbit CLI free-tier rate-limited the apps/desktop scoped review (46-minute wait), leaving that area only covered by the later PR-level review.

The auditor subagent for gsd-secure-phase stalled mid-stream ('API Error: Response stalled') after ~7.5 minutes and died without writing any output, requiring the orchestrator to manually assemble the 109-threat SECURITY.md itself rather than re-spawning a stall-prone agent.
Local git commits repeatedly appeared to time out (likely 1Password SSH signing hang) even though they had actually landed, requiring manual verification via git log instead of retrying.
A background poll script failed because zsh's read-only $status variable was reused as a custom variable name.
GitHub GraphQL mutations for replying to/resolving PR review threads failed silently on first attempts due to known API flakiness, requiring debug output and retries.

The Desktop E2E hard gate (added mid-session by the user) surfaced a genuine, previously-undetected cross-client decryption bug (file_iv hex vs base64) that no unit test, KAT vector, or the 476-test cargo suite had caught.

Even after fixing the decryption bug, Linux desktop-e2e failed on an unrelated Postgres-setup-action version-pinning CI infra error, and Windows failed on a legacy (unmigrated) test helper script, extending the ship loop further.
Log retrieval via `gh` for failed CI steps was initially empty/still flushing, delaying root-cause diagnosis.
